name: Structure: Record the house's language list as a constraint on every mechanism and page on the mechanism map
markdown_description:
P17 and P21. Each mechanism and page on Session 4's map gains a field stating which language versions it carries and against which version of the list, so that the change-reach record's language line, the translation record, and row 132 read one source, and a mechanism that speaks or writes to the roster cannot enter the map without stating how it meets the list. The layer is the map's and adds no mechanism. Extends `86akh6755`, `86akh681a`, and `86akht2gt` by reference. Normal.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
